title: Minimum Cost to Change the Final Value of Expression
summary: Given a valid boolean expression of 1, 0, &, |, parentheses, return the minimum number of operations to make it evaluate to the opposite value. Snippets quote three examples (1&(0|1)->1, (0&0)&(0&0&0)->3, (0|(1|0&1))->1) and mention length up to 1e5, but the full constraint list was not retrieved.
visualizationNotes: Not built: full statement, constraints and examples were not verifiably obtained.
